# gate: `GateOutput`

The `data` payload of `openreadout analyze gate FILE.fcs --workspace W.wsp --json` (or `--gatingml G.xml`), inside the [envelope](envelope.md).

Output of `analyze gate`.

JSON Schema: [`docs/schema/gate.schema.json`](https://github.com/openreadout/openreadout/blob/main/docs/schema/gate.schema.json) · also printed by `openreadout self schema gate`.

## Fields

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | `string` or `null` |  | The FCS file gated; absent when only the gating file was described. |
| `gating_file` | `string` | yes | The gating file (FlowJo workspace or Gating-ML document). |
| `gating_format` | `string` | yes | `flowjo-wsp` or `gating-ml`. |
| `workspace` | [`WorkspaceSummary`](#workspacesummary) or `null` |  | Workspace-level facts (FlowJo only). |
| `sample` | [`SampleSummary`](#samplesummary) or `null` |  | The workspace sample whose gates were used (FlowJo only). |
| `table` | `integer` (uint32) or `null` |  | FCS data set (table) gated. |
| `event_count` | `integer` (uint64) or `null` |  | Events in the data set. |
| `compensation` | array of [`CompensationSummary`](#compensationsummary) | yes | Compensation matrices the gating file defines (and whether any gate used them). |
| `transforms` | array of [`TransformSummary`](#transformsummary) | yes | Transforms by id (FlowJo: by parameter name). |
| `populations` | array of [`PopulationRow`](#populationrow) | yes | One row per population, parents before children. |
| `tree` | array of [`PopulationNode`](#populationnode) | yes | The same populations as a tree (quadrant gates appear as grouping nodes without a count). |
| `notes` | array of `string` |  | Caveats: skipped populations, disagreements with counts stored in the workspace, scaling. |

### WorkspaceSummary

Facts about a FlowJo workspace.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `version` | `string` or `null` |  | Workspace format version (`20.0`). |
| `flowjo_version` | `string` or `null` |  | FlowJo release that saved it. |
| `modified` | `string` or `null` |  | Modification date as written. |
| `groups` | array of [`GroupSummary`](#groupsummary) | yes | Groups and their member sample names. |
| `samples` | array of [`SampleSummary`](#samplesummary) | yes | Every sample in the workspace. |

A workspace sample.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | yes | FlowJo sample id. |

### CompensationSummary

A compensation or unmixing matrix.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` | yes | Matrix name or id; `$SPILLOVER`/`$SPILL`/`SPILL` for the FCS file's own. |
| `source` | `string` | yes | Where it comes from: `workspace`, `gating-ml`, `fcs` or `command-line`. |
| `detectors` | array of `string` | yes | Detectors (columns), `$PnN`. |
| `fluorochromes` | array of `string` | yes | Rows: fluorochromes, or the detectors that receive the unmixed values. |
| `matrix` | array of array of `number` (double) | yes | Row-major coefficients (spillover fractions). |
| `spectral` | `boolean` | yes | More detectors than rows: unmixed by ordinary least squares. |
| `used` | `boolean` | yes | Whether a gate (or the table) used it. |

### TransformSummary

A parameter transform defined in the gating file.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | yes | Id (FlowJo: the parameter it applies to). |
| `kind` | `string` | yes | `linear`, `log`, `arcsinh`, `logicle`, `hyperlog`, `ratio`, `flowjo-log`, `flowjo-biex`, `arcsinh-cofactor`, or the element name of an unsupported FlowJo transform. |
| `parameters` | object: string → `number` (double) | yes | Parameters (`T`, `W`, `M`, `A`, `offset`, `decades`, `neg`, `width`, `pos`, `maxRange`, …). |
| `supported` | `boolean` | yes | False for transforms this reader does not evaluate. |

### PopulationRow

One population.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | `string` | yes | `/`-separated path from the root (`/Lymphocytes/Single Cells/CD3+`). |
| `name` | `string` | yes | Population name. |
| `parent` | `string` or `null` |  | Parent path; absent for populations of all events. |
| `gate_type` | `string` | yes | `rectangle`, `polygon`, `ellipsoid`, `quadrant` or `boolean`. |
| `dimensions` | array of [`GateDimension`](#gatedimension) | yes | Gate axes. |
| `gate` | any JSON | yes | Gate geometry as stored: `vertices`, `mean`/`covariance`/`distance_square`, `foci`/`edge`, or `op`/`operands` (paths, with `complement`). |
| `complement` | `boolean` | yes | Events outside the gate form the population (FlowJo `eventsInside="0"`). |
| `coordinates` | `string` | yes | Coordinates are stored before the transform (`untransformed`, FlowJo) or after it. |
| `count` | `integer` (uint64) or `null` |  | Events in the population (absent when no FCS file was given). |
| `percent_of_parent` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Percent of the parent population's events. |
| `percent_of_total` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Percent of all events. |
| `stored_count` | `integer` (uint64) or `null` |  | The count the gating software stored (FlowJo `count`), for comparison. |
| `medians` | object: string → `number` (double) |  | Median fluorescence (or scatter) of the population's events for each parameter asked for (`analyze gate --median`), keyed by the name as asked: scale values (after `$PnE`/`$PnG`), compensated when the name carries the workspace's `Comp-` prefix. Absent for an empty population. |
